name: palank-harness
description: Thin harness foundry — openCode + tiered routing (minimal/bulk-cheap/terminal-strong/reasoning-frontier) + MCP. Model-agnostic, disposable. Core <250 lines, archive appendix for hashline/worktree.

scripts.lint: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('opencode.json','utf8'));console.log('opencode.json ok')" && node --check mcp/server.js && node --check scripts/check_vault.js && node --check bin/cli.js && echo "lint ok"
scripts.verify: npm run lint --silent && npm run check:vault --silent && npm test --silent
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js 2>&1 || (echo "no tests yet — add per-project tests" && exit 0)
